description.value:
Sound Transit will provide a shuttle from Lynnwood City Center to Shoreline North/185th for passengers requiring the elevator or escalator.   

The southeast entrance of the parking garage will be closed beginning on Saturday, Nov. 21 until 8 a.m. on Nov. 22. The garage will remain accessible via the entrance on 44th Ave. 

See below for shuttle stop locations:  

  
Lynnwood City Center    

- to Federal Way: Lynnwood Station Bay D3    

  
 Mountlake Terrace    

- to Lynnwood: Mountlake Terrace Freeway Station Bay 7  
- to Federal Way: Mountlake Terrace Freeway Station Bay 6  

   
Shoreline North/185th    

- to Lynnwood: Shoreline North Station Bay 1    
- to Federal Way: Shoreline North Station Bay 3  

  
See travel options in the link below to assist you with your ride.

summary.value: Starting at 10 p.m. on Saturday, Nov. 21, until 8 a.m. on Sunday, Nov. 22, the elevators and escalators at Lynnwood City Center Station and garage will be out of service due to a planned power outage.
